name: Kaspa Docs
summary: Source repo for the Kaspa documentation site: integration and development guides written as MDX in a Next.js + Fumadocs app.
description: The documentation site for Kaspa — guides for integrating with and building on the network. Content pages are MDX files under content/docs/ that a Next.js app built with Fumadocs renders into a typed content source and catch-all routes; examples/ holds runnable code samples in Node.js, browser, Rust and Java that back the integration guides, and legacy/ keeps the previous markdown-only documentation. CI checks run on every pull request; missing documentation is tracked in the issues.
contains: guides for integrating with and building on Kaspa
content pages as MDX under content/docs/, rendered by Next.js and Fumadocs
runnable examples in Node.js, browser, Rust and Java
legacy/ keeps the previous markdown-only documentation (not published)
Reference/ holds research papers and LaTeX sources (not published)
CI checks on every pull request; missing docs tracked in issues
